items.title: Refuse an occupied destination when preparing an ECC advisor trial
items.description: I use the ECC advisor trial prepare tool to stage a case into a work tree. If something already sits at the destination path, the tool removes it and replaces it without asking. I lost a staged worktree that way. Preparing a case has to refuse an occupied destination and tell me to clean it up myself, and an existing worktree registration for that path counts as occupied too.
acceptance_criteria: preparing a case at an occupied destination fails instead of overwriting it
an existing worktree registration for the destination path is treated as occupied
